verdict.rationale: Missive is a desktop and web email client, so a telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no such setting or policy. The audit log of every action and the bring-your-own AI API key are different features and do not count as a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
